description: This file defines a Perl module 'metadata' that provides functions and variables for parsing and managing package and target metadata, including reading configuration files, extracting package details, and handling user/group IDs.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, optionally prefixing lines.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specifications, validating IDs and names, and updating corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads a target configuration file and extracts target and profile metadata into structured hashes.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets all package-related global hashes to empty.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Reads a package metadata file, extracts package and source information, and populates global hashes.
